name: OffTrails
tagline: Plans off-trail hiking routes from elevation and satellite data and exports them as GPX.

awards: Best Overall Sponsored By Vobile (1st, 2nd, & 3rd Place)

problem: Cross-country hiking needs careful planning; one miscalculation can be dangerous.
solution: Combines USGS topography with Sentinel-2 water and vegetation data and runs a modified A* search between chosen points, showing the route and exporting it.
demo_moment: Team-described: pick two points and get a downloadable route.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Overall Sponsored By Vobile (1st, 2nd, & 3rd Place)” among 112 submissions.
Uses public scientific datasets for a personal plan.
A two-person team placed in Best Overall.

lessons: Classic algorithms on real public data can beat an AI wrapper.
